summary: The legacy codebase uses VB6 conventions, including form-based UI design and ADO for database operations. Modernization to C# will require adherence to .NET naming conventions, error handling, and security practices.

rules.rule: Use PascalCase for class names and camelCase for method names in C#.
Implement try-catch blocks for error handling in C#.

lint_recommendations: Ensure all methods have XML documentation comments.
scaffold_templates: Use ASP.NET Core for web service scaffolding.
